latest_cos_commentary.headline: Kitchen Armor is a longtime (since 1991) ruggedized kitchen-hardware vendor, now bundling Android and Windows PoE all-in-one touchscreen KDS devices, partnered with QSR Automations/Crunchtime.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes in kitchen_drive_thru hardware (KDS terminals) rather than software; a hardware-layer alternative/complement to Genius's own KDS hardware and software stack, particularly relevant where operators choose best-of-breed rugged hardware separate from their POS vendor.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Recently expanded its hardware line with an Android option alongside its existing Windows-based systems, broadening OS choice for operators.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect already runs Kitchen Armor hardware, confirm whether it's paired with Crunchtime/QSR Automations software or another KDS software layer, since Kitchen Armor itself is primarily a hardware/consulting vendor, not a software platform.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Only one named restaurant customer (Flanigan's) found in public sources; no disclosed leadership team, financials, or independent operator ROI data beyond vendor-published case studies.

verification_needed: operator ROI evidence beyond vendor case study
